HistoryResponse.description:
Discriminated response envelope for any `HistoryRequest` variant.

- `List`            → `HistoryResponse::List(Vec<HistoryListItem>)` - `Read`            → `HistoryResponse::Read(HistoryReadResponse)` - `Archive` / `Unarchive` / `Rename`          → `HistoryResponse::Ack` (success-only)

Added by Task 4C — Phase 4 finalization. Previously the daemon surfaced history results only as a side-channel JSON dump; the router now needs a typed return value to merge cross-agent List results from multiple adapters.
